explanation: Generated input for η electroproduction at W=1.4885 GeV, just 2.6 MeV above the η threshold (W_thresh = m_p + m_eta = 1.4859 GeV). The kinematics are physically valid but extremely close to threshold: the η CM momentum is only ~23 MeV/c, the Born cross section will be very small, and the radiative-correction phase-space integrals (qqt/qqtll) operate in a tight kinematic regime with known convergence risks. The README explicitly notes that near-threshold runs should use the unphysical-skip runner (run_exclurad_skip_unphys.sh) to handle potential numerical issues. No compiler/shell is available to run the code in this environment.
